summary: References a preset digital character from the digital characters library, or an authorized real-person asset added to the asset library after real-person verification. Each asset has its own ID.
combines: Supported on: Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 series (documented in their portrait workflow)
The ID is only a transport handle. Prompts must address the asset as "Image 1", "Video 1", etc.
Digital character library needs activation (ModelArk/2223965); real-person assets need the onboarding flow in ModelArk/2315856.
